enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Metalline: Metalline bypasses any metal based damage reduction. (Adamantine, "Alchemical, Silver", Byeshk, Cold Iron, Mithral)
Shrieking: Shrieking weapons emit a piercing screech whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This screech deals an additional 2 to 12 sonic damage.

Thunderclap: This potent ability will in certain cases send forth a cacophony of sound. On an attack roll of 20, which is confirmed as a critical hit, the target may suffer the following conditions: Stunned, Knockdown, and Disorient.
Resonance +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Spell Penetration II: Passive: +2 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Sonic Lore V: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Proficiency: Greatclub: While equipped this item grants the wielder all required knowledge to wield a Greatclub without proficiency penalties.
